result:
I've made changes for all nine reports. The type check is clean and the full test suite passes (616 tests), but I didn't write new tests for these behaviours.

- **Mentions (1, 2):** mentions now check every active member of the workspace instead of stopping after the first 100, which is why longtime members were missed. Read-only members are no longer skipped. A handle shared by several members mentions all of them. The author's own handle is ignored, and members of other workspaces are never matched. The recorded mentions now come only from the comment text; the list the browser sends with the comment is ignored.
- **Alerts (3, 8):** the issue's author, its assignee and, for a reply, the author of the comment being answered get a "comment added" alert. Anyone also mentioned gets only the mention alert, so nobody gets two alerts for one comment. The comment's author still gets nothing.
- **Thread (4, 5):** in `src/server/repositories/comment-repository.ts`, every reply appears under its top-level comment in posting order, however deep the chain. A deleted comment now stays in the thread as a placeholder with its text removed, so its replies remain visible. The comment count already excluded deleted comments and is unchanged.
- **Edits (6, 7):** the fifteen-minute limit now counts from when the comment was first posted, not from the last edit. An edit re-reads the mentions and replaces the recorded list. Only newly mentioned people are alerted, and the comment is re-indexed so search finds the new text. To do this I added a new `comment.updated` event; the alerts and search code respond to it. Activity and webhook code don't respond to it, so the activity feed and webhooks won't show edits.
- **Posting limit (9):** each member now has their own comment limit, so one person's burst no longer blocks anyone else. The limiter in `src/lib/rate-limit.ts` takes an optional extra argument to key the limit per member.

The main changes are in `src/server/services/comment-service.ts`, `src/lib/mentions.ts` and `src/server/services/notification-service.ts`.
